bug_semantics: CWE-863 cross-organization authorization bypass on HTTP filestore GET. A root-org user with only the reader role (READ_RESULTS) can call GET /api/v1/DownloadVFSFile with attacker-controlled fs_components pointing under the root filestore prefix orgs/<other_org>/... and read arbitrary files from other orgs. CheckAccess is applied only to the current (root) org; the path is not isolated. The reverse does not work because a sub-org filestore does not contain sibling/root org data.
flaw_origin: After multi-tenant support stored child orgs under the root filestore directory /orgs/<org_id>/, PR #2116 added vfsFileDownloadRequest.FSComponents and built the download path with path_specs.NewUnsafeFilestorePath(request.FSComponents...) (no org prefix deny). Combined with GetFileStore(org_config_obj).ReadFile after only READ_RESULTS on the current org, a root-org reader can fetch any child-org file. The VQL fs accessor later grew orgs denials; HTTP handlers did not call IsFileAccessible until the 0.76.4 patch.

reasoning: CVE-2026-6863 is a real published Rapid7/CVE.org advisory (not withdrawn): root-org READ_RESULTS users can HTTP GET other orgs' filestore files. The live mechanism is vfsFileDownloadHandler treating fs_components as an arbitrary filestore path while authorizing only READ_RESULTS in the current org. Child org bytes live under the root org path orgs/, so a root reader stays in-org for ACL purposes and still reads foreign org files; a sub-org reader cannot see root/sibling data in their own store, matching the advisory's one-way note. The smallest first write of those unconstrained path lines is PR #2116 member 83448b40 (FSComponents + NewUnsafeFilestorePath), absent at parent d34aedc6; the GitHub squash abd63a204 is not used as BIC. Multi-org storage and org_id wiring pre-existed and are necessary context, not the first write of the flawed GET path. v0.76.2 is unfixed; the 0.76.4 backport 71655983 (master #4806 / 4bfbb894) adds IsFileAccessible and default-denies orgs. AI attribution is BIC-only: 83448b40 is human Mike Cohen with no commit-object AI markers, so NOT_AI.
